thread:
erin (prod): quick design q — thinking of adding a tiny 'connectivity badge' at the top of the Private setup network step: color + icon + a mini summary. should it include a sparkline of recent checks or just a compact status + history button?
kai (design): i like the badge for at-a-glance, but sparklines imply continuous telemetry. many private installs opt out. propose: badge + short text (e.g. 'Connectivity healthy') and an optional 'Show history' control that reveals a small accessible table of last 5 local checks. no external calls unless consented.
matt (eng): backend note: we can return lastRuns when the agent is allowed to store them. otherwise show only "Last checked X ago". also, store lastRuns in localStorage to avoid re-running probes on refresh. sensitive commands behind an "Advanced" panel. add a flag `share_health` default false for private installs.
harper (a11y): sparklines are not screen-reader friendly. summary text should be explicit: "Connectivity healthy — 5 of 5 recent checks passed". if history is shown, expose it as a table with caption and keyboard focus when expanded. use polite aria-live for updates and assertive only when a new failure appears.
erin (prod): copy tweak: CAE suggested "Connectivity healthy" rather than "good". also want a small 'Why we check this' tooltip linked from badge.
kai (design): will mock badge + history table + tooltip. use color + icon so not color-only. will include reduced-motion and contrast checks.
matt (eng): implementation checklist: respect `share_health`, persist lastRuns locally, fetch deep KB only on demand, protect advanced snippets read-only, add a 'Run checks' CTA and show stale indicator if lastRun > 5m.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch `private-setup-badge` build #5021
harper (a11y): ensure expand moves focus into table and Escape returns focus to badge. announce row count when opened.
erin (prod): owners: kai mock + copy, harper a11y sign-off, matt implement. aim for next sprint grooming. closing thread — thanks! :sparkles:
